original_target.title: The Euler vortex-filament limit for a general moving curve

scope_comparison: Theorem 2 of the source assumes a conservative weak Euler solution and sustained concentration; it does not construct smooth Euler approximations for an arbitrary evolving binormal curve. The 2026 Huang dissertation abstract advertises approximate profiles and perturbations, and the published circular-filament construction concerns weak dissipative solutions, not the stated general smooth-family limit.
